title: Distinguish a complete relaxation from a finite-degree positivity certificate
statement_preview_not_a_proof: Reviewed Cartan/replica hierarchies converge over the full projection domain but retain negative relaxed states at every finite Cartan degree. Sharp free-variable SOS obstructions describe certificate cones, not target negativity.

title: Use convergence after a finite-degree stopping rule fails.
statement_preview_not_a_proof: The complete Cartan hierarchy satisfies0<=g_n/4-alpha_(n,k)<=16*3^n*(3/2)^n/k; k=ceil(16*9^n) gives error2^-n. Yet alpha_(n,k)<0 for EVERY finite k>=2 and n>=3.

title: Identify the certificate cone before using its obstruction.
statement_preview_not_a_proof: For0<=t<=1, minimum identity noise for actual complex positivity, free-real SOS and free-complex SOS is respectively max(0,t-1/2), max(0,(3t-1)/4) and max(0,2*(3t-1)/7). Sharp1/8 and1/7 SOS gaps at t=1/2 persist uniformly in copy number.
